reply_text:
I've saved Ilse's note: from 2026-10-14 she uses Bay 30 for Quarrendon Freight Lines pickups. I replied to her in the DM to confirm.

**Where I saved it:** in my own private memory. The note says it came from her DM and should only be used in conversations with her.

**Where I didn't save it:** I left it out of the shared gbrain brain. That brain is only meant to hold channel history and public files. This connection isn't tied to any one member, so if I saved it there it would be saved as shared by default, and other members could get it back through `recall`. That would break the rule against carrying her DM into anyone else's conversation.
